title: Military marching test: Control and monitoring of stress, exhaustion and performance maintenance through different marching speeds
summary: In an experimental laboratory study, performance, thermal and nutritional parameters as well as cognitive performance parameters will be recorded during operational marching tests on a treadmill in an environmental simulation chamber in order to compare the effects of different marching speeds under different test conditions on stress and fatigue.
conditions: Performance and thermophysiological stress whilst marching with load

interventions.name:
Test condition A: Marching speed 6.0 km/h, load 32kg, climatic condition 25°C, 60% rel. humidity
Test condition B: Marching speed 4.5 km/h, load 32kg, climatic condition 25°C, 60% rel. humidity

Test condition C: Marching speed 6.0 km/h, load 40kg, climatic condition 25°C, 60% rel. humidity
Test condition D: Marching speed 4.5 km/h, load 40kg, climatic condition 25°C, 60% rel. humidity

Test condition E: Marching speed 6.0 km/h, load 32kg, climatic condition 15°C, 60% rel. humidity
Test condition F: Marching speed 4.5 km/h, load 32kg, climatic condition 15°C, 60% rel. humidity

Test condition G: Marching speed 6.0 km/h, load 40kg, climatic condition 15°C, 60% rel. humidity
Test condition H: Marching speed 4.5 km/h, load 40kg, climatic condition 15°C, 60% rel. humidity

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Healthy soldiers
Exclusion criteria:
Acute and chronic illness with limitation of performance, injury that has not healed without consequences, history of heat illness
